claim: DeepSpace apps run on Cloudflare Workers.
label: supported
note: SDK for real-time apps on Cloudflare Workers

claim: DeepSpace deploys apps to Vercel.
label: contradicted
note: deploys to <app>.app.space or a custom domain

claim: npx deepspace deploy ships an app to <name>.app.space.
label: supported
note: deploy command target

claim: The integration proxy fronts more than 215 third-party API endpoints.
label: supported
note: 215+ endpoints via one signed proxy

claim: You don't need to store third-party API keys to call DeepSpace integrations.
label: supported
note: no API keys stored by the developer

claim: Developer-billed integrations reject anonymous callers by default.
label: contradicted
note: api-worker accepts anonymous callers for developer billing; developer must auth-gate

claim: The platform rate-limits every integration call for you.
label: contradicted
note: only restricted integrations (google/*) are rate-limited

claim: Google Workspace integrations require per-user OAuth and are billed to the user.
label: supported
note: google/* per-user OAuth, always user-billed

claim: Permissions are enforced server-side in the Durable Object before records are sent to clients.
label: supported
note: DO checks reads/writes before broadcast

claim: Unauthenticated users get a built-in role called 'anonymous'.
label: contradicted
note: unauthenticated callers use the '*' key; no anonymous role identifier

claim: New authenticated users get the member role by default.
label: supported
note: member is default for authenticated users

claim: Clients can watch, cancel and retry background jobs with the useJobs hook.
label: supported
note: useJobs returns jobs, enqueue, cancel, retry

claim: Background jobs retry three times by default.
label: contradicted
note: default maxAttempts is 1 (no retry)

claim: A background job run is limited to 15 minutes unless its type is listed in backgroundJobTypes.
label: supported
note: alarm wall-time 15 min; backgroundJobTypes for longer

claim: ctx.waitUntil is the recommended way to run long AI generations in DeepSpace.
label: contradicted
note: use JobRoom instead; waitUntil killed 30s after response

claim: Each DeepSpace app can provision one managed AI Search knowledge base.
label: supported
note: one managed instance per app, one ai_search binding

claim: Knowledge search accepts queries of up to 32,000 characters.
label: contradicted
note: max 4,096 characters

claim: Hybrid knowledge search costs $0.825 per 1,000 queries.
label: supported
note: pricing table incl. 10% markup

claim: Scheduled tasks can use a 5-field cron expression evaluated in an IANA timezone.
label: supported
note: schedule + timezone

claim: Only admins can trigger owner-billed scheduled tasks by default.
label: contradicted
note: members and admins can fire them by default

claim: Calling createDeepSpaceAI without an authToken bills the app owner.
label: supported
note: falls back to APP_OWNER_JWT

claim: Anthropic models created with createDeepSpaceAI default to 4,096 max output tokens.
label: contradicted
note: default maxOutputTokens is 64,000

claim: You can enforce one vote per user per poll with a uniqueOn constraint.
label: supported
note: uniqueOn composite constraint checked in the DO

claim: DeepSpace apps scale to millions of concurrent users out of the box.
label: unsupported
note: not stated in corpus

claim: DeepSpace offers a 99.99% uptime SLA.
label: unsupported
note: not stated in corpus

claim: DeepSpace is cheaper than Firebase for most apps.
label: unsupported
note: comparison not in corpus (ADR-0001)

claim: DeepSpace apps are served from over 300 edge locations.
label: unsupported
note: may be true of Cloudflare, but not stated in the DeepSpace corpus

claim: DeepSpace includes Stripe-based subscriptions and one-time payments.
label: supported
note: SaaS with billing via Stripe Checkout
